§ 01 · Overview

The brief.

PillEase is a mechanical pill dispenser engineered to replace the amber vial. Silent magnetic levitation. Press-fit assembly. 90-day capacity. This document is the single, authoritative engineering reference.

Hard Constraint
11.0mm channel width
Non-negotiable. Defines pill compatibility envelope.
Hard Constraint
Press-fit magnets only
No ultrasonic welding. 80°C thermal threshold.
Coverage
Z-SUC: 28–38mm grip
85% of US retail pharmacy vials (13–30 dram).
Budget
$75,000 tooling cap
Multi-cavity injection mold amortization required.

Why & How

Savings justification.

Five compounding factors drive per-unit cost down as volume scales.

1
Tooling amortization
At single-unit run, the $75K tooling cost is fully loaded. At 10,000 units, mold cost amortizes to $7.50/unit, then approaches negligible at 100K+ runs.
2
Multi-cavity injection molding
Gilero quotes a 6× cavity tool that reduces cycle cost on Main Housing from $2.75 → $0.92 at 10K volume. Same dynamic applies to all 4 ABS components.
3
Volume tier pricing — N52 magnets
KJ Magnetics tier breaks: 1–99 units at $0.71 ea, 100–999 at $0.48, 1,000–9,999 at $0.31, 10,000+ at $0.19 per magnet (2× per device).
4
Silicone LSR overmold scale
Xometry LSR setup cost ($1,200 NRE) amortizes over volume. Per-unit silicone sleeve drops from $1.90 → $1.10 → $0.62 across the three tiers.
5
Shipping consolidation
Pallet/container freight at 10K units reduces logistics cost by 88% vs LTL single-unit shipping. Component shipping line drops from $2.85 → $0.42/unit.

Injection Molding Strategy

Transitioning to mass manufacturing using the $75,000 tooling budget.

Benchmark Specification / Standard Target Outcome Status
Multi-Cavity Molding High-volume tool paths Drive COGS to $4.50 target ○ Pending
Overmolding 40A silicone over rigid housing Ergonomic integration ○ Pending
Ultrasonic Welding Heat staking ABS anchors Secure N52 magnets ⊘ Prohibited
⚠ DFM Override

Ultrasonic welding is STRICTLY PROHIBITED on magnet-adjacent assemblies. The 80°C thermal threshold will demagnetize N52 components. Substitute press-fit + medical-grade epoxy or cyanoacrylate per Master DFM Spec.
